versions.changelog: The helper connects through Beatra's mainland network when your computer is in mainland China, and can open the approval page on Beatra's international site when you need another sign-in method.
The helper now waits for your approval, and if you approve after it has stopped waiting, Beatra connects automatically the next time you use it, with no second approval.
Balance and cost questions now answer from a live account read rather than from figures written into the package.

- Added podcast episode and recurring show support, with new routing for podcasts.
- Refined routing logic: now locks medium first (long narration, multilingual, or brand clone) before directing requests.
- Updated documentation for required consent and clarified prohibition on unauthorized voice imitation.
- Removed obsolete skill-card.md file.
- Minor refinements to workflows and clarified supported routes and edge case handling.
Ask for a top-up before cloning a brand voice; script reads still start from the library.
Publish the reviewed Voiceover & Narration Studio workflow with its English ClawHub listing.
